text: 美国财政部数据显示，美国8月主要海外美债持仓分化。 日本持仓降至1.068万亿美元，创2024年12月以来的最低位，环比减少360亿美元。 作为第二大持有国，英国持仓则升至1.010万亿美元——首次突破1万亿美元大关，增加120亿美元。 8月中国持有的美国国债降至5910亿美元，较7月减少270亿美元。
text_en: U.S. Treasury Department data show that major overseas holdings of U.S. Treasuries diverged in August. Japan's holdings fell to $1.068 trillion, the lowest since December 2024, down $36 billion month on month. The United Kingdom, the second-largest holder, saw its holdings rise to $1.010 trillion—breaking above the $1 trillion mark for the first time, an increase of $12 billion. China's holdings of U.S. Treasuries fell to $591 billion in August, down $27 billion from July.
